title: Appointment as Statutory Audit
bodyHtml:
Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, Ghaziabad in tends to invite the expression of interest from the CA firms for appointment as statutory audit for conducting the audit of its office for the financial year 2017-18.

Interested firms practicing Chartered accountant with least 3 year of experience in auditing and empanelled with the comptroller and Auditor General of India are requested to send their Expression of interest in undertaking the works, sealed offer, quoting the competitive Remuneration/ Fees in Annexure-1 (attached) with profile of the firm along with staff available, description of audit handled during last 3 year and location of office etc. to take up the audit of the commission.

Expression of the interest to be deposited in person or by post in the office of Secretary-Cum-Scientific Director, India Pharmacopoeia Commission, Sector-23 Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad-201002 till 07.08.2018 by 12 noon in a sealed cover.
